scripts.text:
- Wait a moment! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please come back later -
- after you put some items into kafra storage. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！ -
- 你攜帶的物品太多了。 -
- 請先把部分物品存進卡普拉倉庫，再回來。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Ummmm...
What brings you here...?
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
嗯...
來找我有什麼事...？

scripts.text: Make Potion
scripts.translation: 製作藥水

scripts.text: Talk.
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Mixing Information
scripts.translation: 調配說明

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Why are you carrying these so many!
Don't be greedy, carry only as much you need!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
您怎麼帶了這麼多東西！
別貪心，只帶您需要的數量！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You are too heavy to receive potions from me...
Go store some items in your storage first!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
你負重太高，拿不了我的藥水...
先去倉庫存點東西！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You have all the stuff ready, right? Which one would you like?
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
材料都準備好了嗎？您想要哪一種？

scripts.text: Red Potion.
scripts.translation: 紅色藥水

scripts.text: Orange Potion.
scripts.translation: 赤色藥水

scripts.text: Yellow Potion.
scripts.translation: 黃色藥水

scripts.text: White Potion.
scripts.translation: 白色藥水

scripts.text: Blue Potion.
scripts.translation: 藍色藥水

scripts.text: Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 綠色藥水

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want anything.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不要

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You rascal! What did you expect?! Coming here with nothing. Tsk!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
你這小鬼！你指望什麼？！兩手空空來這裡。哼！
快滾！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
How many?
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
要多少？

scripts.text: Make as many as I can.
scripts.translation: 儘量多做

scripts.text: I want to choose an amount.
scripts.translation: 指定數量

scripts.text: Actually, I don't want anything.
scripts.translation: 什麼都不要

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You rascal! You don't even have all the materials and you want me to make you potions?!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
你這小鬼！材料都不齊，還想讓我給你做藥水？！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Then pick a number below 100. If you don't want any, just enter '0'. With the materials you have, you can make about {0} potions.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
選一個小於100的數量，不想要就輸入0。
你現有的材料，大約能做{0}瓶藥水。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Make up your mind, will you?!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
你到底想怎樣？！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Are you deaf? I said less than 100!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
你聾了嗎？我說了，小於100！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
You rascal! You don't even have all the materials and you want me to make you potions?!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
你這小鬼！材料都不齊，還想讓我給你做藥水？！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
What?!
Grrr...
Bleh!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
什麼？！
Grrr...
Bleh!
滾開！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Here you go. It's all done so you can take it. But remember! Abusing medicine is not good.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
給你，都做好了，拿走吧。
記住！藥可不能亂用。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
What?!
Grrr...
Bleh!
Get lost!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
什麼？！
Grrr...
Bleh!
滾開！

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
With medicine, you can increase a person's ability to regenerate. But, they're only good up to a point. *Sigh* I'm starting to think of the days when I was young. I must be getting old.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
藥物能促進身體恢復，但效果也有個限度。
*嘆氣*又想起年輕時的事了，我大概是真的老了。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Anyways, a potion is merely a potion. Nothing more and nothing less.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
總之，藥水終究只是藥水，別指望它無所不能。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Hrrrmm...
You young ones can be quite annoying. But, since you asked, I'll explain.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
Hrrrmm...
你們年輕人真煩，不過既然問了，我就講講。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
Herbs work well by themselves, but if you use my special techniques and skills to make potions out of them, the effect is much much greater.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
藥草本身就有藥效，但用我的獨門技藝製成藥水，效果會好得多。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
If you ask eagerly and politely, I will make them for you. But, not for free... Don't worry though, I only charge a small fee, so it's not that expensive.
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
如果你誠懇禮貌地請求，我會為你製作。但不是免費的...不過別擔心，我只收取少量費用，所以並不貴。

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]

scripts.text:

White Potion - ^0098E52 White Herbs, 1 Empty Bottle, 20 zeny fee.^000000

藍色藥水 - ^0098E52株藍色藥草、1個空瓶，費用30 Zeny。^000000
綠色藥水 - ^0098E52株綠色藥草、1個空瓶，費用3 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Old Pharmacist]
What a boring person. If you have something to say, why don't you say it?!
scripts.translation:
[老藥劑師]
真是個無聊的人。有話就說，為什麼不說出來？！
